Definition: Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Shelomith is the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses, and the verses show the range. One is the sister of Zerubbabel's sons, one kept the dedicated things with his brethren, and one is the mother of the Israelitish woman's son who blasphemed the name of the LORD and was brought unto Moses. The name means peaceful.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name Shelomith, peaceful, sits strangely beside the blasphemer's story, and that is the point. Peace is not a name but a life, and I hold that the mother's name could not cover her son's sin.
